title: DECISION: Dual-CID model separates dedup from IPFS address
description: Dual-CID model in cid_util.rs. Canonical CID (0x55 raw, SHA-256 wire bytes) for dedup map only. Root CID (0x71 DAG-CBOR) for IPFS addressing only. Root CID is not stable across ingests because HLC and operator signature differ. A single-CID approach would break either dedup or IPFS addressability.
